prompt: From exact commit abc123 in one clean repository, create the profile-resolved contributor worktree, make the scoped local commit, and hand it off without pushing.
expect: Inventories the common Git directory, refs, worktrees, and dirty state before mutation.
Uses the supplied branch profile and records exact base and resulting head in the repository slice.
Stops after the local handoff commit and does not infer push or cleanup authority.

prompt: Commit these edits and merge them, but the base is unspecified and an existing dirty path has no known owner.
expect: Uses read-only checks for available ref facts and blocks the mutation on unresolved intended base or dirty-path ownership.
Performs no checkout, commit, merge, stash, reset, or cleanup.
Does not choose a floating default branch as a substitute.

prompt: Show repository status, the last three commits, and the current diff; make no changes.
expect: Recognizes the request as read-only and does not require the mutation workflow.
Does not create a branch, worktree, commit, tag, or handoff packet.
Stops after reporting the requested facts.

prompt: Execute an approved first-publication RemoteSyncPlan that selects only stable main. Its exact verified local head and expected empty remote revision are supplied with push authority. An archive, integrated sessions, and historical worktree branches exist locally but are absent from the plan.
expect: Consumes the approved plan and resolves only main to an exact refspec without adding the archive, session, or historical branches.
Verifies the exact local head, expected remote revision, intended paths, plan freshness, and push authority before execution.
Pushes only the named refspec, re-reads the remote result, and records exact or partial execution evidence.
Does not decide synchronization need or timing and does not use --all, --mirror, bulk tags, deletion, or force update.
